PAGE: dmv.ca.gov — Schedule an Appointment

PAGE CONTENT (what the person came for):
Skip to content
Appointments
Know Before You Go
DMV does not provide counter service for vehicle registration renewal, driver’s license/ID card renewal (unless specified on notice), driver and vehicle records, or replacement driver’s licenses. These services must be done online, at a DMV kiosk, with a DMV business partner, or by mail.
Graphic with the heading ‘DL Customers’ showing a sample California driver’s license on the left. To the right, text encourages customers to save time by completing their driver’s license application online before their DMV appointment.
Start Application
Appointment services selection page.
Do you need to visit the DMV?
Most DMV services are available online. Only visit a DMV office for the services below.
Appointment solutions
MAKE AN APPOINTMENT:
Renew DL/ID or Vehicle Registration (with changes or in-person requirement) Renew DL (Seniors Age 70+) Replace DL/ID Driving Permit First-time DL Application First-time REAL ID Application Commercial DL Application Reduced/No Fee ID Card Application Reinstate Driving Privilege Remove DL Record Restriction(s) Name Change Gender Category Request
Schedule Your Appointment
If you received a notice from DMV about requiring a knowledge test re-evaluation, book an expedited appointment.
To schedule a drive test with a DMV representative, select one below:
Already have an appointment?
Cancel or review your appointment details.

texto: Estás en la página de citas del DMV de California. Para renovar la licencia, esta página indica que normalmente debes hacerlo en línea, en un kiosco, con un socio del DMV o por correo, y que la cita en oficina solo es necesaria si hay cambios o requisito presencial. La opción de cita que te corresponde es «Renew DL/ID or Vehicle Registration (with changes or in-person requirement)» o, si tienes 70 años o más, «Renew DL (Seniors Age 70+)»; ambas están entre los servicios para los que se puede agendar una cita en la página. También hay un botón «Start Application» para llenar la solicitud de licencia en línea antes de la cita.
